//go:build !wasip3

package main

import (
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"os"
)

// main serves the handlers with stock Go's server: http.ListenAndServe on -addr, the configuration
// directory -config.
func main() {
	addr := flag.String("addr", "127.0.0.1:8080", "the address to listen on, HOST:PORT")
	flag.StringVar(&configDir, "config", "", "the configuration directory, which holds app.conf")
	flag.Parse()
	if configDir == "" || flag.NArg() != 0 {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "usage: p3svc -config DIR [-addr HOST:PORT]")
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, http.ListenAndServe(*addr, newMux()))
	os.Exit(1)
}
